```{=html}
<p id="visitor-counter" class="visitor-counter" hidden>
  You are the <span class="visitor-count"></span> visitor!
</p>
<script>
  // "1" -> "st", "12" -> "th", "1,042" -> "nd"
  function ordinal(count) {
    var n = parseInt(String(count).replace(/\D/g, ""), 10) % 100;
    if (n >= 11 && n <= 13) return "th";
    return { 1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd" }[n % 10] || "th";
  }

  // Home page visitors from GoatCounter; the site code lives in goatcounter.html.
  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    // Sit directly above the GitHub link instead of under the last section.
    var links = document.querySelector(".about-links");
    if (links) links.parentNode.insertBefore(document.getElementById("visitor-counter"), links);
    var tracker = document.querySelector("script[data-goatcounter]");
    if (!tracker) return;
    var url = tracker.dataset.goatcounter.replace(/\/count$/, "/counter/%2F.json");
    fetch(url)
      .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(r.status); })
      .then(function (data) {
        var counter = document.getElementById("visitor-counter");
        counter.querySelector(".visitor-count").textContent = data.count + ordinal(data.count);
        counter.hidden = false;
      })
      .catch(function () {});
  });
</script>
```
